title: All Icons fills the available palette space.
description: Removed the height cap that left a blank gap below All Icons. The icon catalog now scrolls with the palette, while search and category headers remain visible.

before.caption: A fixed-height icon list leaves unused space

after.caption: Icons continue to the bottom of the palette

note: Works at different window and palette sizes. Search, Favorites, drag-and-drop and the separate icon picker retain their behavior.
